LIDAR Composite DTM covers approximately 99 percent of England
LIDAR Composite DTM spatial resolution is 1 metre
DTM removes surface objects to model terrain surface
DTM is produced from the last or only laser pulse returned
Composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys

2022 composite survey span is 2000-06-06 through 2022-04-02

Elevation values are presented in metres
Vertical reference is Ordnance Survey Newlyn
Current composite metadata documents OSTN15 transformation method
Input LIDAR surveys document vertical accuracy of plus or minus 15cm RMSE
Official dataset exposes a WCS resource for LIDAR Composite DTM 1m
Official DSP guidance documents persistent lidar-composite-digital-terrain-model-dtm-1m WCS URL

OS Terrain 50 grid has 50m post spacing
OS Terrain 50 publishes contours at 10m intervals
OS Terrain 50 is intended for broad applications over large areas

OS Terrain 50 is free to use and available for download

Planning Data entity search supports dataset filtering
